items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Were you with Silstan when Clem Rabin played with him? ... INTERVIEWEE: Well, I wouldn't say.

ctx.x: No, I was supposed to go there, but I never did.
